bio.text: Melissa Strange, a Democrat originally from Villa Hills, is a candidate for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District in 2026; she lives in Erlanger.
She is a supply chain professional with 27 years of experience in the sector.
She has a bachelor's degree in international studies from Northern Kentucky University and an MBA from Thomas More, and has volunteered as an academic team coach for 16 years.

sources.title: Democrat Melissa Strange announces run for Massie's seat
